## Decisions (recorded at implementation)

- **One migration, not two.** `dismissed_explainers` and `runs.gate_overrides` both land in
  `0032_approval_surface.sql` — two `IF NOT EXISTS` column adds on the same ticket, no reason to
  split the file (the `0032_approval_explainers.sql` draft was consolidated before commit).
- **Auto-proceed derives from the kind, never the caller.** `buildGateCard` consults
  `NEVER_AUTOPROCEED_GATES` itself: a poisoned `onExpiry` on a spend/refusal kind cannot surface a
  countdown or a proceed path — the invariant is enforced at the view-model layer, asserted by the
  kind × activity matrix test (AC4's property-test clause).
- **`ord` is a one-based destination.** The plan-edit decoder (`gate-edits.ts`) uses
  remove-and-insert reorder semantics; section rows are tagged by original index so multiple moves
  in one submission don't drift.
- **Per-run overrides layer, not replace.** `resolveGatePolicy` accepts the project's facts plus an
  optional `runOverrides` layer; `null` removes a deadline (wait), a larger number lengthens, and
  only wait-default kinds accept a ≥2 h add — `approvalOverridesSchema` is the single validator both
  the project settings route and the per-run route call.
- **`gates_off` is the "Approve and run autonomously" flag end-to-end.** The sheet's
  `autoProceedRun` body field freezes `runs.gates_off` at create (`run-routes.ts`); the same flag is
  set by the card's autonomous action mid-run (`resolveGate`, P0.10). Named gates then skip
  `by:'policy'`; spend/refusal/`continue_rounds` still open (REQ-SPEC-1).
- **Policy facts ride the run spec.** `HarnessRunSpec.gatePolicy` carries the resolved project
  policy + overrides + `gatesOff` into `runCommitLoop`, which builds its `GatePolicyContext` from
  `gatePolicyContextFromFacts` — a `deps.gateContext` binding (tests) still wins.
- **The identical-card contract is literal.** `ApprovalRow`'s `<details>` sheet mounts the same
  `<GateCard>` element the Timeline/run-card path renders — one component, one model, asserted by
  rendering a row whose expanded markup contains the full `data-gate-card` anatomy.
- **Explainer state lives on the user row.** `dismissed_explainers text[]` follows the
  `app_theme`/`project_group_by` pref-column pattern; `GET /settings/explainers` +
  `POST …/dismiss` are the only writers.
- **`decisions` is optional on `RunCardView`.** Older fixtures (web server tests) build runtime
  views without it; the renderer defends with `view.decisions?.length ?? 0` so back-compat fixtures
  keep passing.
